        current_time = self.Time.time()

            self.Liquidate(symbol)
            self.held_contract = None
            self.entry_price = None
            self.no_entry_today = True
            return

        # Scheduled Time Stop: 15:45 NY time on trading day immediately preceding contract expiration date
        now = self.Time
        if now.time() >= time(15, 45):
            expiry_date = symbol.ID.Date.date()
            if self.IsPrecedingTradingDay(now.date(), expiry_date):
                self.Debug(f"Time stop triggered at 15:45 on day before expiration for {symbol.Value}. Liquidating.")
                self.Liquidate(symbol)
                self.held_contract = None
                self.entry_price = None
                return

        if self.entry_price is not None and self.entry_price > 0:

            ask = sec.AskPrice
